title: Gaussian fluctuations for the stochastic wave equation with drift
summary: In this article, we study the spatial fluctuations of the solution to the stochastic wave equation with a nonlinear drift and multiplicative Gaussian noise in dimensions one and two. The noise is white in time, and its spatial covariance is either integrable or given by a Riesz kernel; space-time white noise in dimension one is also included. We establish spatial ergodicity, convergence of the rescaled covariance, and prove a quantitative central limit theorem for the spatial fluctuations.
